name: normativepdf
description: Clause-driven PDF library in pure TypeScript. Every behaviour tied to an ISO 32000 clause; what cannot be tied is not claimed.
author: shuji-bonji

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check && npm run build && node scripts/parse-corpus.mjs && node scripts/roundtrip-corpus.mjs
scripts.corpus:survey: npm run build && node scripts/parse-corpus.mjs --survey corpus/veraPDF-corpus
scripts.roundtrip:survey: npm run build && node scripts/roundtrip-corpus.mjs --survey corpus/veraPDF-corpus --qpdf
